decision: accepted within local arm64 runtime-package receiving scope
source_review: Unique strict realpath dependency resolution and basename collision refusal precede destination creation.
Only the new receiver copies receive load-command/rpath and ad-hoc signature changes.
Current package contains all admitted non-system dependencies with direct local loads; installed Homebrew bytes remain unchanged.
This review does not execute session_doctor, rebuild or replay process controls, operate on user sessions/hardware, or replace the separately owned historical receiver.
limitations: Architecture verification is arm64 only; no universal/x86_64 or notarized distribution claim.
The script refuses an existing destination and does not claim an atomic package transaction after a mid-assembly failure.
